description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different probing models, categorized by the type of perturbation applied to the embedding layer. The x-axis represents the probing model, with categories including embedding, first layer, and various random models with perturbations labeled as B2, L2, R2, and PERMUTE. The y-axis measures accuracy, ranging from 70 to 95. The embedding and first layer models are represented by blue and green bars, respectively, while the random models with perturbations are shown in red. The unperturbed trained model is depicted in orange. The accuracy values for the embedding and first layer models are consistently high, around 82 to 83, indicating robust performance. The random models with perturbations show a range of accuracies, generally lower than the embedding and first layer models, with some perturbations like PERMUTE slightly improving accuracy. The unperturbed trained model has the highest accuracy, reaching up to 92, suggesting that the training process significantly enhances the model's performance.
